facts.normalized_proposition: Nummular dermatitis can produce intensely pruritic, well-demarcated coin-shaped eczematous plaques.
Coin-shaped bilateral plaques without burrows or a person-to-person exposure pattern are less consistent with scabies.
Well-demarcated circular or oval plaques on the limbs or trunk, especially with xerosis, favour nummular dermatitis.

next_action_branches.trigger: typical coin-shaped eczematous plaques without infestation features
next_action_branches.action: Treat the eczematous process with skin-barrier care and topical anti-inflammatory therapy; investigate contact allergy or infection when indicated.

packets.single_source_exception: One current specialty reference directly covers the candidate; independent semantic review required.

facts.normalized_proposition: Bedbug bites can cause pruritic papules after household exposure.
Exposed-site grouped bites without scabetic burrows or the characteristic scabies distribution favour bedbugs over scabies.
New crops of pruritic papules after sleeping in an infested environment favour bedbug bites.

next_action_branches.trigger: compatible bites with environmental evidence of infestation
next_action_branches.action: Arrange environmental eradication and symptomatic skin care.

packets.single_source_exception: One current specialty reference directly covers presentation, differential diagnosis, confirmation, and coeliac evaluation; independent semantic review required.

facts.normalized_proposition: Dermatitis herpetiformis is an intensely pruritic papulovesicular eruption.
A symmetric extensor eruption with enteropathy differs from a painful unilateral dermatomal zoster eruption.
Grouped excoriated vesicles on extensor surfaces with coeliac disease favour dermatitis herpetiformis.

next_action_branches.trigger: suspected dermatitis herpetiformis
next_action_branches.action: Confirm with appropriate skin testing and evaluate for associated coeliac disease.

packets.single_source_exception: One current specialty reference directly covers the phototoxic eruption; independent semantic review required.

facts.normalized_proposition: Phytophotodermatitis can produce painful erythema and blisters.
Linear lesions confined to sun-exposed plant-contact sites and later hyperpigmentation differ from dermatomal zoster.
A painful non-itchy linear blistering eruption after plant sap and ultraviolet exposure favours phytophotodermatitis.

next_action_branches.trigger: recognized phototoxic plant exposure
next_action_branches.action: Stop the exposure, protect from ultraviolet light, and provide symptomatic skin care.

facts.normalized_proposition: A blue nevus is a pigmented melanocytic lesion that can enter the differential for melanoma.
A small symmetric blue-grey lesion that remains unchanged is less suspicious than an evolving asymmetric melanoma.
A longstanding solitary smooth blue-grey papule with stable size and shape favours a common blue nevus.

next_action_branches.trigger: new or changing blue lesion or diagnostic uncertainty
next_action_branches.action: Perform dermoscopic assessment and biopsy or specialist referral when melanoma cannot be excluded.

facts.normalized_proposition: Solar lentigo is a common benign pigmented macule on chronically sun-exposed skin.
Uniform colour and long-term stability reduce concern relative to an evolving variegated melanoma.
A sharply demarcated, uniformly pigmented, stable macule on sun-damaged skin favours solar lentigo.

next_action_branches.trigger: atypical or changing lentigo-like lesion
next_action_branches.action: Use dermoscopy and biopsy when melanoma in situ cannot be confidently excluded.

facts.normalized_proposition: Appendicitis is an important gastrointestinal alternative cause of vomiting and abdominal symptoms during pregnancy.
Persistent vomiting with starvation, dehydration, and no focal peritoneal findings favours hyperemesis over appendicitis.
Progressive focal abdominal pain with localized tenderness or peritoneal findings favours acute appendicitis.

next_action_branches.trigger: pregnancy with focal abdominal pain or peritoneal findings
next_action_branches.action: Obtain urgent surgical and obstetric assessment with pregnancy-appropriate imaging.

facts.normalized_proposition: Diabetic ketoacidosis is a metabolic alternative cause of vomiting and physiologic compromise in pregnancy.
Hyperglycemia, acidosis, and ketonemia beyond starvation ketosis favour diabetic ketoacidosis rather than hyperemesis.
Vomiting with diabetes, metabolic acidosis, and significant ketonemia favours diabetic ketoacidosis.

next_action_branches.trigger: suspected diabetic ketoacidosis in pregnancy
next_action_branches.action: Begin urgent metabolic stabilization while confirming glucose, ketones, electrolytes, and acid-base status.

facts.normalized_proposition: Nuchal translucency ultrasound is a first-trimester screening component relevant to aneuploidy risk assessment.
Nuchal translucency and cell-free DNA differ in method, timing, and screening information and neither is a diagnostic karyotype.
A patient choosing first-trimester ultrasound-based risk assessment or needing structural information may appropriately receive nuchal translucency assessment.

next_action_branches.trigger: abnormal screening result or ultrasound marker
next_action_branches.action: Provide counselling and offer appropriate diagnostic testing rather than treating the screen as diagnostic.

facts.normalized_proposition: A cervical lesion can cause antepartum vaginal bleeding.
Cervical-source bleeding without uterine tenderness or fetal compromise is less consistent with placental abruption.
Bleeding visualized from a cervical lesion on speculum examination with a non-tender uterus favours a cervical source.

next_action_branches.trigger: suspected non-placental cervical bleeding after placental location is assessed
next_action_branches.action: Perform appropriate speculum evaluation and arrange investigation of the cervical lesion.

facts.normalized_proposition: Preterm labour can present with bleeding and painful regular contractions before 37 weeks.
Cervical change with regular contractions favours preterm labour; a tense tender uterus and fetal compromise favour abruption.
Regular contractions with progressive cervical dilation or effacement favour preterm labour.

next_action_branches.trigger: suspected preterm labour
next_action_branches.action: Assess maternal-fetal status and cervical change promptly and initiate gestation-appropriate obstetric management.

facts.normalized_proposition: Cow's milk protein allergy can produce gastrointestinal manifestations and can affect infant growth, so it may enter a broader gastrointestinal differential when allergic features coexist.
A classic withholding-retention pattern with fecal loading directly supports retentive fecal incontinence rather than allergy.
A reproducible cow's-milk relationship plus other allergic or inflammatory gastrointestinal manifestations would increase suspicion for cow's milk protein allergy.

next_action_branches.trigger: credible allergy features accompanying gastrointestinal symptoms
next_action_branches.action: Undertake a clinician-supervised allergy-focused assessment rather than attributing retentive incontinence to allergy alone.

packets.candidate_label: Offer access to culturally safe trauma-informed care
Use de-identified consultation for clinical advice
Offer a structured family meeting with the authorized decision-maker

facts.normalized_proposition: Rumination disorder can present with recurrent regurgitation and can be confused with self-induced vomiting.
Regurgitation not driven by weight or shape overvaluation differs from binge eating followed by compensatory behaviour in bulimia nervosa.
Effortless recurrent regurgitation without binge episodes or weight-shape motivation favours rumination disorder.

next_action_branches.trigger: suspected rumination disorder
next_action_branches.action: Complete feeding/eating and gastrointestinal assessment and arrange behavioural treatment appropriate to rumination.

facts.normalized_proposition: Anorexia nervosa and bulimia nervosa both involve weight and shape overvaluation and disordered eating.
Persistently low weight with restriction and no recurrent binge-purge pattern favours anorexia nervosa, restricting type.
Significantly low body weight maintained by restriction without recurrent binge eating or purging favours anorexia nervosa, restricting type.

next_action_branches.trigger: suspected anorexia nervosa
next_action_branches.action: Assess medical instability and nutritional risk promptly and refer for coordinated eating-disorder treatment.

facts.normalized_proposition: Dependent and borderline personality disorders can both involve intense interpersonal dependence and fear of separation.
Submissive clinging and difficulty making decisions without reassurance differ from borderline instability, impulsivity, anger, and self-harm.
A pervasive pattern of submissive care-seeking, difficulty making everyday decisions, and fear of being unable to care for oneself favours dependent personality disorder.

next_action_branches.trigger: suspected dependent personality disorder
next_action_branches.action: Confirm the longitudinal pervasive pattern and arrange appropriate psychotherapy-focused care.

facts.normalized_proposition: Complex post-traumatic stress disorder can include affect dysregulation, negative self-concept, and relational disturbance that overlap with borderline presentations.
A trauma-linked syndrome with PTSD features and disturbances in self-organization differs from a pervasive borderline pattern not contingent on trauma reminders.
Core PTSD symptoms plus persistent affect, self-concept, and relational disturbance after prolonged trauma favour complex post-traumatic stress disorder.

next_action_branches.trigger: suspected complex post-traumatic stress disorder
next_action_branches.action: Perform trauma-informed assessment, evaluate safety and comorbidity, and arrange evidence-based trauma-focused care.

facts.normalized_proposition: Vortioxetine is an evidence-based antidepressant option for major depressive disorder.
Vortioxetine cannot be assumed inferior to an SSRI without patient-specific treatment history, tolerability, and preference information.
Prior inadequate response or a patient-specific reason to select vortioxetine can make it a reasonable antidepressant choice.
A monoamine oxidase inhibitor is an antidepressant strategy that can be effective in selected depressive illness.
Interaction burden, dietary restrictions, and specialist-monitoring requirements make an MAOI inferior to a standard first-line SSRI in an uncomplicated initial presentation.
Treatment-resistant or selected atypical depression under specialist management may justify an MAOI after safer first-line options are inadequate.

next_action_branches.trigger: considering an MAOI after inadequate standard treatment
next_action_branches.action: Use specialist-guided prescribing with medication-interaction review, washout planning, and dietary counselling.

packets.single_source_exception: One comprehensive current specialty guideline directly compares aspiration with catheter drainage; independent semantic review required.

facts.normalized_proposition: Therapeutic thoracentesis removes pleural fluid and can transiently relieve symptoms.
Established complicated parapneumonic effusion or empyema requires ongoing infected-collection drainage; one-time aspiration alone is inadequate source control.
A free-flowing non-infected symptomatic effusion may be managed with therapeutic aspiration when continuous drainage is not indicated.

next_action_branches.trigger: confirmed pleural infection or low-pH complicated parapneumonic effusion
next_action_branches.action: Insert an image-guided small-bore chest tube and give appropriate antibiotics.

packets.single_source_exception: One current international emergency-surgery guideline gives a strong high-quality recommendation; independent semantic review required.

facts.normalized_proposition: Serial abdominal examinations are relevant to many evolving abdominal presentations.
When acute mesenteric ischemia is suspected, serial observation delays the recommended immediate CT angiography.
Serial examinations are appropriate only after a time-critical vascular catastrophe has been sufficiently excluded or while definitive care is already underway.

next_action_branches.trigger: clinical suspicion of acute mesenteric ischemia
next_action_branches.action: Perform computed tomography angiography without delay.

packets.single_source_exception: One current international emergency-surgery guideline directly establishes CT angiography as the diagnostic study of choice; independent semantic review required.

facts.normalized_proposition: Plain abdominal radiography is a familiar initial investigation for some acute abdominal syndromes.
Plain radiography cannot evaluate mesenteric arterial or venous occlusion and must not delay CT angiography for suspected acute mesenteric ischemia.
Plain radiography may address another suspected abdominal process but is not the definitive urgent vascular test for mesenteric ischemia.

next_action_branches.trigger: clinical suspicion of acute mesenteric ischemia
next_action_branches.action: Proceed directly to computed tomography angiography rather than relying on plain radiography.
